sasha: Heads up — AtlasRack pushed the ETA window for the APAC rack shipment. Original 2026-04-10 -> 2026-04-14 window moved to 2026-04-18 -> 2026-04-25 due to port congestion + customs hold. This touches Dedicated APAC tranche (resv ID: R-2026-041). Need quick call on re-alloc or mitigations.
kevin: Confirmed receipt of revised manifest. Atlas attached manifest and noted 2x-week delay. We can: (A) reassign some capacity to US pool, (B) pay for air-freight for priority racks, or (C) use cloud marketplace burst for non-sensitive workloads. How many racks are critical?
oliver: Top-impacted customers: AlphaHealth (private, data residency), BetaBank (SLA), Caravelo (can tolerate short region shift). AlphaHealth cannot accept cross-region.
jess: Product note — for customers with latency SLAs we should avoid cross-region unless temporary routing + cache. Could we soft-route non-sensitive traffic to US and keep a subset local?
michael: Short-term workaround: we have 4 DGX nodes in reserved US pool we can redirect to handle level-1 traffic. I can trigger a reserve move. Example command (mock):
```
resv move R-2026-041 --to us-west-2 --count 4 --tag temp-APAC-fallback
```
This will reduce APAC capacity by those 4 nodes.
tia: Legal: if we reroute customer workloads across regions we need to review data residency clauses for AlphaHealth and BetaBank. I'll prioritize AlphaHealth contract review by EOD.
atlas_rep: AtlasRack update: apologies. Port Y had a backlog after weekend storm + customs paperwork delay. We can offer air-freight for priority SKUs — earliest ship ETA 2026-04-21 if booked today. Quote ID Q-555 sent; uplift ~$28k per rack (estimate).
maria: So options summary: 1) Move 4 nodes to US this evening (mitigates some SLA risk). 2) Air-freight 1-2 racks for AlphaHealth at cost. 3) Marketplace burst for non-sensitive customers. Need approvals and cost sign-off.
frank: Quick finance estimate: air-freight ~$28k/rack (urgent rate), expedited customs handling ~$4k. Marketplace burst + short-term egress/network ~$6k/week for our traffic profile. I'll produce a firm number in 2 hours.
sasha: Good — action items: (1) Tia to confirm AlphaHealth contract constraints by EOD (@tia) (2) Kevin to schedule `resv move` for 4 nodes to us-west-2 by 22:00 PT (3) Atlas to send air-freight invoice & earliest ship date (AtlasRep please confirm) (4) Eng infra to prepare fallback routing + cache policy for non-compliant customers by tomorrow 10:00 PT.
kevin: Scheduling now. Will post deploy plan and reservation IDs once done.
atlas_rep: Invoice and AWB will be in your inbox within 30m. Air freight seat confirmed for up to 2 racks on 2026-04-21.
michael: Eng infra: will stage routing rule: if APAC resv < 70% then route non-sensitive inference to us-west-2 and enable prefix KV cache for 48h. Will post the rule snippet once tested. :thumbsup:
maria: Noted. I'll coordinate comms to affected customers after legal & finance sign-off.
sasha: Thanks team — ping here if anything changes. I'll set a 30min sync if Atlas ETA slips again. :eyes:
